provenance: Scripted action outcomes from distinct simulated incidents; not human reports or claims of autonomous choice.

histories.positive: I coordinated the incident response with the crew before closing it.
histories.negative: I handled the incident response alone without coordinating with the crew.
histories.expectation: I usually coordinate the incident response with the crew.

histories.positive: I independently verified the incident records with a checklist before closing.
histories.negative: I closed the incident without independently verifying its records with a checklist.
histories.expectation: I usually independently verify incident records with a checklist.

tasks.situation: A small operations team has conflicting incident reports and limited time. Choose which step to prioritize before closing the case.

options.text: Ask the people involved to reconcile their accounts together.
Independently cross-check the records against a checklist.

tasks.situation: You inherit a partially completed operations handoff with an ambiguous note. Both approaches fit the available time. Choose one first step.

options.text: Arrange a short joint review with the people who handled it.
Reproduce the relevant checks yourself using the recorded evidence.
